Sandbox_StayQuiet_Enabled_tooltip: When off, Stay Quiet never spawns hordes from distant sounds.
Sandbox_StayQuiet_ChancePercent_tooltip: Percent chance a qualifying distant sound triggers a Stay Quiet horde.
Sandbox_StayQuiet_CooldownDays_tooltip: Minimum days between Stay Quiet hordes. Distant meta gun events are roughly every few days; raise this to force more spacing.
Sandbox_StayQuiet_TriggerRadius_tooltip: World sounds smaller than this radius are ignored. Larger radius means farther / bigger noises.
Sandbox_StayQuiet_HordeSizeMin_tooltip: Minimum zombies requested for a Stay Quiet horde. Actual size is rolled between min and max.
Sandbox_StayQuiet_HordeSizeMax_tooltip: Maximum zombies requested for a Stay Quiet horde. Actual size is rolled between min and max.
Sandbox_StayQuiet_SpawnDistMin_tooltip: Minimum tiles from the nearest player to the spawn ring. Rolled between min and max.
Sandbox_StayQuiet_SpawnDistMax_tooltip: Maximum tiles from the nearest player to the spawn ring. Rolled between min and max.
